title: Re-Volt/Pick Ups
text: The game features several Power-Ups, all of which help you in different ways. They are gained by collecting bolt-shaped Pick Ups scattered all across the tracks, and each Pickup can give you any random Power-Up to activate. Pick Ups spawn right upon start of the race (when you see "Go!" in the middle of the screen). Pick Ups will respawn after some time upon being collected, and they be used for your benefit and advantage against opposing racers during race. But watch out! Pick Ups can also be unfavorable to you because opposing racers can also use them for their own benefit against you.
